purpose: Three-owner declarative machine setup and harness exposure.

actions.intent: Execute the complete configured local gate before publishing this repository.
actions.recovery: Read the failed owner job; repair its source or declared prerequisite, then rerun the full local gate. Fixture acceptance does not authorize cloud/device deployment.

actions.intent: Re-evaluate the retained domain decision using its owning regression/contract.

learning.summary: A dotfile audit may discover setup suggestions but must not execute setup or modify the host automatically; exercise disposable configuration fixtures.
